item.title: Quad raffle raises more than $40,000 for campaign to renovate community centre
item.description: The raffle for a 2025 Honda Rubicon quad raised over $40,000 to support renovations of the Fort St. John Association for Community Living's Terus Community Centre.

item.title: Court ruling describes ‘nomadic lifestyle’ of Tumbler Ridge shooter’s family
item.description: The family of Tumbler Ridge shooter Jesse Van Rootselaar led a "nomadic lifestyle" marked by multiple moves between at least three provinces, a British Columbia court ruling says.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge killings prompts very different start to B.C. legislative session
item.description: A new session of the British Columbia legislature opened today, February 12th, with a speech from the throne about the Tumbler Ridge deadly school shooting.

item.title: Police in B.C. investigate four pedestrians struck in separate crashes
item.description: Police in three B.C. communities are investigating four vehicle crashes involving pedestrians in the last week. Two women were killed in separate accidents in Surrey, about 13 hours apart. item.title: Short-lived ‘secure and hold’ implemented at Dawson Creek school in week of Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: A 'secure and hold' was issued for the Dawson Creek Secondary - South Peace Campus at 1.15 p.m. on February 12th.

item.title: NEBCCF launches Tumbler Ridge Community Resilience Fund
item.description: The Northeast BC Community Foundation (NEBCCF) says the fund is designed to support long-term recovery in the community, following February 10th's mass shooting.

item.title: Listen: Mother of Tumbler Ridge shooter interviewed about struggle to get care for another child two years before tragedy
item.description: Jennifer Jacobs, the mother of the Tumbler Ridge shooter, spoke out about healthcare shortages in northeast B.C. just over two years before she was one of the first victims of a mass shooting perpetrated by her child, Jesse Van Rootselaar.

item.title: Fort St. John council considers snow clearing policy adjustments after $484K budget overspend
item.description: The City of Fort St. John council is considering adjusting its snow-clearing policy after it spent $484,000 more than its budget to tackle snowfall in December 2025.

item.title: Tse’k’wa cave collaborates with university professor on free educational resources
item.description: The Tse’k’wa Heritage Society and professor emeritus of Simon Fraser University (SFU), Dr. Jon Driver, have collaborated on new educational resources about the cave in Charlie Lake.

item.title: Drop-in mental health appointments available in Tumbler Ridge after shooting
item.description: Following the school shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School on February 10th, Northern Health is offering people access to mental health clinicians at the Tumbler Ridge Health Centre.
